Name: PrairieControls - Journey Of The Prairie King mod
Author: Synthicated
Description:
Having trouble completing "Journey of The Prairie King" without dying, but don't want to cheat? I have a compromise... [b]"PrairieControls" mod![/b]
This mod allows you to shoot with the cursor in the arcade minigame "Journey of the Prairie King", which makes the controls much easier

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the required version of the mod[/*]
[*]Find the game's root directory, where Stardew Valley.exe or StardewValley.exe is located. You can find the game's root directory [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]here[/url][/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into the Mods folder[/*]
[*]Play and have fun - it's easy![/*]
[/list][b]How it works[/b]
[list]
[*]Left-click to shoot[/*]
[*]You can disable this feature in the [color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url] [/color]settings[/*]
[*]The mod is safe to delete if you no longer need it[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url] [optional][/*]
[/list]
